title: Chapter 145
content:
Chapter 145

Following Yan Chunjun's voice, the atmosphere in the hall froze, and everyone held their breath, not daring to make any loud movements.

"Hehe, before, I thought that the country of Yan was such a difficult bone to crack. Only now did I realize that this country, known as one of the Seven Heroes of the Warring States Period, is nothing more than that!" It popped out of Zhong Yu's mouth.

"Bold, who are you? How dare you speak such wild words!" Before Yan Chunjun could speak, many people in the hall stood up, glared at Zhong Yu, and cursed endlessly.

What's more, the sword has been drawn out of its sheath, and it seems that if Zhong Yu doesn't have a good explanation, it seems that blood will splatter on the spot.

"Who is your Excellency? You dare to say such a thing in front of my Lord Yanchun in the capital of my country of Yan. I think there must be some background. Are you from Qin or Qi?" Others in the hall were furious, but Lord Yanchun No, as some of the most powerful rulers of the Yan Kingdom, he clearly understands that the Yan Kingdom is not as powerful as imagined.

The people around were a little surprised, how could Lord Yanchun, who is usually domineering and authoritarian, act like this? It seems that he is secretly afraid of something.

It's just that they don't understand Yanchun Jun's concerns.

As the top ruler of the Yan Kingdom, it is just a joke to be able to have these things just by relying on his royal status.

His own strategy is also indispensable, at least he belongs to the more outstanding part of the royal family of Yan Kingdom. Otherwise, King Yan has so many immediate family members, dozens if not hundreds, how could it be Lord Yanchun's turn to take the throne.

From the time he saw those people, the aura, dress, and behavior of each of these people showed that they were extraordinary.

Especially the person at the head is even more majestic than the Yan Wang I have seen, this is not something that can be easily pretended.

He must have this kind of experience, he has been a superior for a long time, and he must be in a country no smaller than the country of Yan, so that he can have this kind of kingly image.

But in my mind, recall it. He didn't find the king of the Six Kingdoms who matched the person in front of him, so he let go of the absurd thought in his heart that the person in front of him was the king of other six countries.

Just take it as the person in front of you, the other three big countries in the south, Qin Qichu, these three top powers in the world, and the noble prince of one of them!

But this is already amazing.

Any one of the princes in power in these three countries has a higher status and more power than Lord Yanchun, so Lord Yanchun must be careful to find out, so as not to bring disaster to his own country and bring disaster to his country. bring trouble on themselves.

"I'm not from Qin and Qi, let alone from the other six countries. You don't have to be careful here to test it out. Who am I? You have never heard of it before, and neither have the people in this world, but it's not much. For a long time, the whole world will be shaken by my arrival and bring about new changes!" Seeing Mr. Yanchun's careful thinking, Zhong Yu sneered, and then uttered some crazy words that others thought .

"Oh! Your Excellency, since you are not from the Six Kingdoms, and it seems that you are not from the Yan Kingdom, where do you come from? Is it the north?" Lord Yanchun didn't care when he heard the wild words of the man in front of him, thinking he was Young and frivolous. Just hearing that he is not from the other six countries, I have some doubts in my heart. Could it be that he is from the north? But how could those northern wolves have such a magnanimous king?

"That's right, I am a person from the north, someone who came from the more northern part of your country of Yan, which is even more bitter and cold!" Zhong Yu responded directly without trying to hide it.

"It turns out that a group of grassland barbarians dared to act recklessly in my country of Yan. Have you forgotten the story of Qin Kai, the general of the country of Yan, defeating your Donghu people and plundering thousands of miles?" The defeat of the Donghu tribe in the north, and the record of capturing the land of thousands of miles in Liaodong for the Yan Kingdom, has just passed more than 20 years, and the entire Yan Kingdom is still familiar to everyone.

"Hu people, you seem to have made a mistake. I am not the group of northern wolves who drink blood. Look at my appearance and behavior. Are you those lowly prairie barbarians?" Zhong Yu sneered a few times.

"Oh, it's not those prairie barbarians, is that the remnant of the Shang Dynasty in the east, Jizi North Korea?" Lord Yanchun thought for a while, the colder places in the north of Yan Kingdom, apart from Jizi North Korea, there is only Donghu.

"How can those people who are living on their last days be compared with me!" Very disdainful, Zhong Yu heard the contempt on Ji Zichao's face.

"That's not it, that's not it, it seems that you are just a person who speaks outrageous words, come here, take him down for me, and let him be punished!" People from North Korea, let alone people from the South, that can only prove that he is the descendant of a certain school. Although Lord Yanchun was afraid of these schools, he did not take them too seriously.

"Heh, it wouldn't be better to do it earlier, it's a waste of my words!" Seeing Yanchun Jun's impatience, Zhong Yu was also a little impatient.

After a few swipes, a few black shadows flashed by, but they were a few masters in the world, with their sharp weapons out of their sheaths, they were attacking in Zhong Yu's direction.

However, before these black shadows attacked the second floor, several hidden guards behind Zhong Yu took the initiative to stop those black shadows, and these black shadows fell from the second floor amidst a few knives, lights and fire shadows. Going down, there were a few bang bangs, but there was no sound at all.

"Okay, very good, let me tell you, why do you have the guts to contradict me? It turns out that there are so many masters in the rivers and lakes who serve as your bodyguards, and you really have something to rely on. It's just that you think that with these people, you can be unrestrained in my country of Yan. It's too much You must be arrogant!" Yanchun Jun clapped his hands a few times, gritted his teeth and said with hatred.

"Jueying, you go to me, kill them, don't keep your hands"

"Yes, Your Majesty."

Beside Yanchun Jun is a middle-aged man, dressed in plain clothes, but holding a sword in his hand, which looks like a good sword weapon.

With a scoff, the sword in Jueying's hand was already out of its sheath, and he waved it a few times, as if adapting to the sharpness of the long sword.

After debugging and feeling that there is no problem, he suddenly attacked in the direction of Zhong Yu and the others on the second floor.

"Changshan Zhao Zilong is here, the enemy general is going crazy!" Zhong Yu shouted loudly from behind, and Zhao Yun, who was dressed in white, pulled out the long spear he was carrying on his body, and killed the person in front of him.

"Hey, you bastard, Zhang Fei from Yan is here, how can you allow you to be presumptuous?" Seeing that his opponent who had long been in love was preempted by Zhao Yun, a boy next to him, Zhang Fei yelled angrily, and stood up. The Zhang Ba Snake Spear beside him stabs forward.

Seeing the two masters rushing forward in front of him, the aura exuding from their bodies was impressively first-rate, Jue Ying's complexion changed, his intuition and perception as a strong man told him that neither of these two men in front of him was inferior to he.

He quickly withdrew and went back, holding his sword upright in front of his chest, confronting Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei.
